Klasse DrawableObject

java.lang.Object
treptowkolleg.plot.DrawableObject
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
schimkat.berlin.lernhilfe2025ws.graphics.Drawable, CustomDrawable
Bekannte direkte Unterklassen:
PlotGraph, PlotGrid
public abstract class DrawableObject extends Object implements schimkat.berlin.lernhilfe2025ws.graphics.Drawable, CustomDrawable
An abstract base class for drawable objects that provides common rendering infrastructure. This class automatically computes the drawing area dimensions and center coordinates from the graphics context before invoking custom drawing logic.

Important licensing notice: This class implements the Drawable interface, which is provided exclusively for use within the courses taught by Dr. Schimkat at the Berlin University of Applied Sciences (Berliner Hochschule fuer Technik, BHT). Redistribution, public release, or use outside this educational context is not permitted under Dr. Schimkat’s license terms.

For any reuse beyond the original course setting (e.g., in personal projects, open-source repositories, or other educational contexts), you must create a project-local alternative interface such as:

package your.package;

import java.awt.Graphics;

public interface Drawable {
    void draw(Graphics g);
}

and refactor all implementing classes to depend on that instead.

    • draw

      public void draw(Graphics g)
      Renders this object by first extracting the current drawing area dimensions from the graphics context, computing the center point, and then delegating to the configure methods for custom drawing implementation.
      Angegeben von:
      draw in Schnittstelle CustomDrawable
      Angegeben von:

      Parameter:
      g - the graphics context used for rendering

    • adjustXDelta

      protected void adjustXDelta()
      Adjusts the global X offset to enable smooth horizontal scrolling during live data acquisition (e.g., in serial plotting). This method modifies PlotApplication.X_DELTA based on the current scale factors.

      protected int getScaledX(int value)

    • getScaledY

      protected int getScaledY(int value)
      Converts an integer y-coordinate from data space to screen space using the current scaling and center offset. Note: The y-axis is inverted (higher data values appear higher on screen).
      Parameter:
      value - the y-coordinate in data units
      Gibt zurück:
      the corresponding y-coordinate in pixels

    • resetTransform

      protected void resetTransform()
      Resets the transformation of the internal Graphics2D context to its state at the beginning of the draw(Graphics) call. This is useful when custom drawing code has applied rotations, translations, or scaling that should not persist.

    • resetTransform

      protected void resetTransform(Graphics2D g2d)
      Resets the transformation of the given Graphics2D context to the original state captured at the start of rendering.
      Parameter:
      g2d - the graphics context to reset; must not be null

    • getG2D

      protected Graphics2D getG2D()
      Returns the internal Graphics2D context used for advanced rendering. This context has anti-aliasing enabled and is ready for custom drawing.
      Gibt zurück:
      the current Graphics2D instance
